definitions.ask: Should the Highlights (H) picker get the same count header, scope line, and rail as the code and link pickers?
definitions.why: All three pickers share RefsSectionedWindow and the card, so one component keeps them consistent

choices.label: H, C, and L pickers all get the count header, scope line, rail, and live digit hint
Only C and L change; the H picker keeps today's header, hint, and messages
